actors.incentive: receive expected execution or safe rejection

actors.incentive: earn fees without hidden liability drift

actors.incentive: extract value, grief, or create trusted false evidence

actors.incentive: fees, side payments, or censorship leverage

actors.incentive: receive aggregation or proof-market rewards without losing admissibility

control_classes.description: Bind action receipts to explicit state roots and critical substate hashes.
Commit to deterministic ordering, serialization, and transcript hashes.
Require the exact verifier, signer, policy, evidence class, and scope authorized for the action.
Rejected traces must leave committed state unchanged.
Value-moving roles need slashable downside or a hard authority cap.
Observable timing, error, and status surfaces must be classified and budgeted.
Metadata, ordering, storage, and receipt fields must not become unbounded coordination channels.
Terminal receipts close over every required upstream proof, policy, registry, and economic receipt.
Devnet, fixture, O2, replay, public-testnet, and production evidence classes are non-interchangeable.
Critical actions must respect value-at-risk tiers for quorum, freshness, reporter independence, and economics.
Production and public-testnet profiles reject weaker flags, malformed booleans, faucet modes, and path lookup.
Bound parser, verifier, search, retry, and transport work before attacker-controlled inputs choose cost.
Models, rankers, simulations, and subagents rank candidates but cannot authorize settlement or public claims.
User-facing or operator-facing controls block unsafe action classes before signing or committing.

scenarios.title: Alice swap with Mallory boundary MEV and stale quote reuse

game_surface.players: Alice signs a swap, Bob supplies pool liquidity, Mallory observes metadata and may influence inclusion, the sequencer orders or withholds.
game_surface.actions: submit intent, quote route, admit batch, reorder within allowed window, settle or reject
game_surface.information_sets: public mempool hints, quote age, batch boundary, pool reserves, visible reject class
game_surface.timing: quote build, user signature, batch close, settlement commit
game_surface.state: pool reserves, quote certificate, settlement profile, nonce, batch transcript
game_surface.payoff: Mallory profit from stale quote, profile drift, or inclusion timing minus costs

scenarios.attack_query: exists Mallory strategy: profit_atoms > 0 while stale or profile-drifted quote is accepted

exclusions: external venue arbitrage outside the settlement profile

scenarios.disaster_state: settlement accepts a quote certificate under stale state, wrong profile, or Mallory-controlled batch-boundary information

side_channels.channel: error class reveals exact quote age or pool path before batch close
side_channels.control: deterministic reject class with redacted public detail and full private receipt

covert_channels.channel: partial-fill or retry metadata signals batch-boundary decisions
covert_channels.control: canonical batch transcript and bounded retry envelope

scenarios.mechanism_update: Settlement profiles must be transcript-bound and quote reuse must fail closed when state, profile, or batch identity differs.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: MalloryAcceptGain <= rejected_value_atoms + slash_or_fee_cost_atoms under the fixed admission model

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: negative stale/profile-drift replay with reject-is-no-op state check

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No global MEV elimination or unknown side-channel absence claim.

scenarios.title: Oracle reporter collusion captures median value

game_surface.players: Mallory controls or bribes reporters, honest reporters submit fresh values, governance chooses feed policy.
game_surface.actions: register reporter, deposit bond, submit report, aggregate, dispute, slash, consume critical read
game_surface.information_sets: reporter set, bond size, value-at-risk, report windows, dispute evidence
game_surface.timing: registration, report submission, aggregation, critical action admission
game_surface.state: reporter registry, feed policy, aggregate receipt, dispute ledger, slash ledger
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gain from moving the aggregate minus expected slash and future value lost

scenarios.attack_query: exists two controlled reporters in median3: critical read accepted and DefectGain > expected downside

assumptions: rational detection probability encoded by numerator and denominator
slash and rewards in integer e8 units
exclusions: hidden real-world beneficial ownership unless separately attested or disputed

scenarios.disaster_state: a median3 feed authorizes a high-value action while two accepted reporters are within Mallory's control budget

side_channels.channel: report timing leaks which reporters are needed to swing the aggregate
side_channels.control: receipt-level timing disclosure policy and bounded observation fields

covert_channels.channel: reporter metadata or ordering fields coordinate colluding reports
covert_channels.control: canonical report transcript with non-semantic metadata excluded from aggregate authority

scenarios.mechanism_update: Critical feed policy needs value-at-risk tiers that reject or downgrade weak quorum structures under the modeled control budget.

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: collusion envelope rejects median3 control when bonded downside is below value-at-risk, plus reporter economics replay

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No hidden-beneficial-owner closure claim from on-chain artifacts alone.

scenarios.title: Proof-mining duplicate reward and claim replay

game_surface.players: Mallory submits proof work, verifier checks receipts, reward manager pays approved claims.
game_surface.actions: submit claim, mutate proof metadata, replay payout, withdraw or reassign reward
game_surface.information_sets: claim identity, proof hash, verifier identity, reward pool, previous payouts
game_surface.timing: claim submit, verification, reward assignment, payout commit
game_surface.state: claim ledger, proof receipts, payout nonce, reward pool balances
game_surface.payoff: duplicate reward extraction minus slash, clawback, and future exclusion

scenarios.attack_query: exists replay or alias of a valid claim: payout accepted twice or reward pool goes negative

bounds: nonce is a deterministic integer or hash

scenarios.disaster_state: one proof-carrying task pays more than once or mutates authority after verification

side_channels.channel: verifier timing reveals which mutation is closest to acceptance
side_channels.control: stable rejection families and bounded diagnostic disclosure

covert_channels.channel: claim metadata encodes off-protocol coordination for reward splitting
covert_channels.control: metadata excluded from payout identity or committed as non-authoritative

scenarios.mechanism_update: Reward eligibility must be a function of canonical proof identity, verifier profile, and payout nonce, with duplicate rejection before balance mutation.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: DuplicateRewardGain <= SlashAmount + FutureValueLost after deterministic duplicate detection

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: stateful replay mutator showing duplicate and alias claims reject with no state change

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No claim that every future proof-market payout mode is covered.

scenarios.title: Perps or zUSD action reuses stale or wrong oracle state

game_surface.players: Alice holds a position or vault, Mallory targets liquidation or mint path, reporters provide oracle values.
game_surface.actions: report price, build authorization, mutate vault or position root, liquidate, mint, settle funding
game_surface.information_sets: oracle freshness, position root, vault state, collateral root, action id fields
game_surface.timing: oracle observation, action authorization, state mutation, commit
game_surface.state: positions, collateral, vault debt, oracle receipt, risk parameters
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gain from stale price or unbound state root minus rejected action cost

scenarios.attack_query: exists action authorization with matching opaque id but stale oracle value or mismatched state root that still commits

exclusions: oracle-source external market manipulation beyond declared feed model

scenarios.disaster_state: critical perps or zUSD action commits using a receipt that is fresh for one state but applied to another

side_channels.channel: liquidation rejection detail reveals margin threshold search information
side_channels.control: bounded reject detail for public responses and full private audit receipt

covert_channels.channel: optional action fields signal privileged oracle windows
covert_channels.control: schema-total action facts with canonical optional-field policy

scenarios.mechanism_update: Critical action authorization must bind the consumed oracle value to the exact position, collateral, vault, and risk-parameter roots.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: AttackGainFromStaleRoot <= 0 when root mismatch rejection precedes any state mutation

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: negative stale-root and wrong-value tests for each critical action family

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No broad oracle correctness claim beyond scoped authorization binding.

scenarios.title: Cross-shard or watcher metadata becomes covert finality channel

game_surface.players: Mallory observes watchers, sequencer posts or delays shard summaries, governance configures finality thresholds.
game_surface.actions: post summary, delay body, reorder watcher attestations, reveal status fields, finalize or timeout
game_surface.information_sets: posting order, watcher height, timeout window, summary roots, status endpoint fields
game_surface.timing: local shard commit, summary posting, watcher quorum, timeout finality
game_surface.state: summary set root, watcher quorum, local ledger effects, finality status
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gain from learning or steering finality before public canonical receipt

scenarios.attack_query: exists metadata or timing signal that lets Mallory coordinate profitable inclusion or censorship before finality receipt is canonical

exclusions: network-layer traffic analysis outside application transcript fields

scenarios.disaster_state: non-authoritative watcher or posting metadata acts as an unbounded covert channel for finality or censorship coordination

side_channels.channel: status endpoint timing reveals pre-finality state
side_channels.control: bounded status classes and finality-state redaction before quorum

covert_channels.channel: posting order or watcher metadata encodes off-protocol messages
covert_channels.control: canonical summary-set root and non-authoritative metadata exclusion

scenarios.mechanism_update: Finality claims must depend on canonical receipts and quorum roots, while observer metadata remains bounded and non-authoritative.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: CovertSignalValue <= cost_of_censorship_or_withholding under timeout and quorum policy

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: bounded metadata audit plus negative watcher/posting drift replay

scenarios.title: Production configuration disables a required verifier or bridge

game_surface.players: Mallory supplies malformed config or environment, governance/operator deploys profiles, release gate checks posture.
game_surface.actions: set flag, omit verifier, enable fixture mode, start service, admit critical action
game_surface.information_sets: deployment profile, environment variables, release manifest, startup logs
game_surface.timing: build, package, deploy, startup, first critical action
game_surface.state: runtime policy, key policy, verifier policy, oracle bridge policy
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gains weaker authority path or fixture signing surface

scenarios.attack_query: exists production profile with weaker verifier, bridge, key, faucet, or path-lookup flag that starts and admits a critical action

assumptions: deployment profiles are checked before service start
exclusions: manual operator bypass outside the checked launch path

scenarios.disaster_state: production or public-testnet service starts with a weaker authority surface than the profile claims

side_channels.channel: startup error detail reveals production secret or profile internals
side_channels.control: stable public failure code and private diagnostic log redaction

covert_channels.channel: unused config fields carry off-protocol launch instructions
covert_channels.control: schema-total config parser rejects unknown or malformed production fields

scenarios.mechanism_update: Release profiles must fail closed on weaker flags, malformed booleans, missing verifier contracts, fixture keys, faucet modes, and path lookup.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: ConfigBypassGain <= 0 because startup or admission rejects before the weakened service can commit value

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: negative production-profile tests for each required bridge and verifier flag

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No production readiness claim until release gates and public evidence manifests pass.

scenarios.title: Advisory model or subagent output tries to authorize settlement

game_surface.players: Model ranks candidates, Mallory supplies prompt or corpus poison, verifier checks deterministic receipts, user or operator consumes recommendations.
game_surface.actions: rank trace, propose patch, generate receipt-like text, request promotion, settle or reject
game_surface.information_sets: model score, candidate trace, verifier result, replay command, evidence manifest
game_surface.timing: research search, candidate selection, verifier run, claim promotion
game_surface.state: advisory artifacts, replay receipts, claims registry, settlement state roots
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gains authority by laundering advisory output as verifier evidence

scenarios.attack_query: exists advisory output that changes settlement authority, state root, or public claim without a local verifier accepting the scoped statement

assumptions: models have no direct imports into verifier-critical paths
exclusions: human manual override outside repo gates

scenarios.disaster_state: advisory search result or subagent transcript becomes authority for settlement, state roots, or production claims

side_channels.channel: model confidence or trace order reveals private search priorities
side_channels.control: publish only verifier-backed evidence and scoped residual-risk summaries

covert_channels.channel: model-generated fields mimic receipt IDs or verifier labels
covert_channels.control: receipt parser accepts only deterministic local verifier output with schema and hash checks

scenarios.mechanism_update: Advisory systems may rank candidates, but verifier gates alone decide settlement authority and public claim promotion.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: AdvisoryGainFromForgery <= 0 when forged evidence has no authority and verifier mismatch rejects

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: authority-boundary tests showing advisory output cannot authorize settlement or enter state roots

scenarios.title: Recursive lifecycle packet replay or stale aggregate admission

game_surface.players: Alice and Bob rely on recursive lifecycle proofs, Mallory supplies stale or malformed packets, the sequencer orders packets, the proof aggregator assembles child receipts, governance configures verifier policy.
game_surface.actions: aggregate child receipts, compute asset-delta rows, bind header fields, submit recursive packet, verify, admit or reject
game_surface.information_sets: child receipt roots, aggregate asset-delta root, proof profile, public policy hash, feature suite hash, packet reject class
game_surface.timing: child proof close, recursive packet assembly, ledger admission, Tau export
game_surface.state: header roots, proof metadata, recursive lifecycle admission packet, aggregate asset-delta rows, verifier profile
game_surface.payoff: Mallory gain from making stale, malformed, or wrong-profile recursive evidence appear admissible

scenarios.attack_query: exists stale or malformed recursive packet accepted while any header-bound root, aggregate asset-delta root, proof profile, or child receipt set differs from the ledger context

exclusions: cryptographic soundness of RISC0 receipt verification beyond local verifier result

scenarios.disaster_state: ledger or Tau admission accepts recursive lifecycle proof evidence whose packet is stale, malformed, wrong-profile, or asset-delta divergent

side_channels.channel: packet reject class reveals exact mutation distance or missing child position
side_channels.control: stable public reject class with detailed diagnostics kept in private replay evidence

covert_channels.channel: child receipt order, unused packet fields, or aggregate-row ordering encodes off-protocol coordination data
covert_channels.control: schema-total packet validation, sorted unique asset rows, canonical transcript binding, and unknown-field rejection

scenarios.mechanism_update: Recursive lifecycle proof admission requires a packet checker bound to the actual ledger header and proof metadata before any recursive proof packet can advance checked heights.
scenarios.game_theory_condition: MalformedPacketGain <= 0 because stale or malformed recursive evidence rejects before height acceptance and leaves no accepted app-hash output

evidence_lane.promotion_requirement: reject-is-no-op integration tests for missing, malformed, and stale recursive packets plus checker tests for packet obligations

promotion_boundary.non_claim: No claim that recursive proof aggregation closes all covert channels or proves RISC0 receipt soundness.
